package.isolation: The harness copied the task-owned package into an exclusively owned disposable fixture. It did not use an existing user instance or save.
package.scope: Package identification comes from the separate manifest and assembly inspection. This lifecycle run is not itself a Steam download or installation-provenance test.

test_execution.resource_boundary: Exported test binary with frozen source resources; the separate exported_native_fixture_keeps_its_source_resources regression passed on the same binary.

convar_readback.path: Production generation-bound runtime command dispatcher; no external RCON client
convar_readback.response_validation: Exact convar name and quoted typed value; wrong values, unrelated names, pending text and duplicate replies are rejected

save_evidence.native_log_observation: Saving complete and Config Saved appear in the stopped-run logs; subsequent starts spawn entities from a save.
save_evidence.scope: The production receipt remains Requested, not Confirmed. Native completion logs, generated save files, file-level backup/restore and later native reloads are separate observations; they do not upgrade this receipt into a durable-write or exact requested-checkpoint verification.

il_references.finding: The no-argument quit path calls ServerMgr.Shutdown, marks Rust.Application.isQuitting, stops the network server with reason quit, then calls GetCurrentProcess().Kill(). Rust.Application.Quit follows at IL_0070; this evidence does not claim Application.Quit(-1).
Passes integer -1 to Microsoft.Win32.NativeMethods.TerminateProcess for its process handle.

production_control_flow: commands_instance_stop::stop_run awaits request_instance_graceful_shutdown before normal-stop finalization.
Rust declares server.save then quit with no fallback. request_instance_graceful_shutdown requires the complete managed process tree to exit; otherwise it returns an error without forced stopping.
stop_active_instance_processes refuses normal finalization unless the supervisor already confirms that the complete process tree is not running.
native_quit_evidence.interpretation: The native quit log, successful production stop path, verified self-termination implementation and observed -1 agree. LanGame did not substitute a forced stop. Rust's own quit implementation terminates its own process with -1; this is distinct from the successful test harness exit code 0 and from the initial failed run's cleanup exit 0xC000013A.
native_quit_evidence.audit_scope: The disposable fixture was cleaned after completion. This conclusion uses retained native logs, lifecycle results and the reviewed production/native control flow; it does not claim a separately retained desktop audit log.

navigation_and_seed.uploaded_cache_filename: The seedless MapCache filename uses World.Timestamp; its initial zero and later timestamp are not the configured seed.
navigation_and_seed.scope: Native RustNav logs show initial generation and later loading of the saved navmesh whose filename includes the configured size and seed. The legacy -useOldNavmesh branch and a live RCON seed query were not exercised.

storage_lifecycle.prestart_update: Pinned policy verified on every cycle; download bytes not measured
storage_lifecycle.restart: Fresh managed run and persisted configuration readback verified
storage_lifecycle.scope: File-level restore and isolated archive recovery were exercised. No existing user instance, library or save was the target of these deletion or restore operations.

regression_chain.detail: Four new convar queries and one manual save succeeded; the following shutdown save failed during the sixth WebRCON handshake. Normal stop was not completed.
Endpoint-shared connection admission retains failed and in-flight attempts, waits before sending, and never replays a command. No native limit, fixture pacing or RCON protocol change.

Accepted fixture sockets explicitly use blocking mode while retaining their two-second read/write timeouts and all assertions. This corrected three initial mock-peer failures; it did not change production admission.

regression_chain.stage: focused units on the frozen binary
regression_chain.detail: All 12 websocket-filter tests passed, including the six admission regressions, production GM and save-then-quit dispatch tests, and frame/deadline coverage.
The original four-query plus single manual-save sequence was retained in all four cycles, followed by the declared production save/quit path.

focused_unit_proof.scope: Focused tests only; this is not a claim that the entire desktop unit suite passed.

log_review.stderr: Complete file read and every distinct normalized line reviewed; repeated historical log tails are not counted as additional runtime events
observed_native_warnings: DungeonGridRoot was absent for dungeon navmesh generation
Boat AI entity kill requests referred to already destroyed entities
log_review.scope: Warnings were retained in the raw evidence. This is not a claim of warning-free gameplay.

limitations: No client join, player gameplay or performance benchmark.
No native legacy Source RCON run or old-navigation branch.
No network program update or fresh-download behavior tested by this lifecycle fixture.
Manual-save receipt remains Requested; no exact requested-checkpoint content roundtrip was established.
Other RCON clients using the same source IP can still consume native connection allowance.
Credentials, instance identifiers, hostnames and absolute task paths are omitted.
